title: Subjects
description: GET /subjects. Every account the target holds, in entitlement vocabulary, which subject the add-on's bindings name each for, every binding that names none because another account holds its name or number, and how far to trust the read. Every subject has an account, so every subject carries standing.

current.description: This answer comes from a read of the app that began after the request arrived, and whose shape the add-on has checked.

truncated.description: The read hit its cap; it cannot support a conclusion about absence.

conflicts.description: Every binding that names no account in this read because another account holds its name or number. Empty: none. A subject listed here is on no row. Required, even empty, so a reply says it carries attribution: Syndra reads a binding on no row and in no conflict as deleted, and an add-on from before attribution says neither.

subject.description: The Syndra subject the add-on's binding names this account for: the role SCIM's externalId plays (RFC 7643 section 3.1). Absent: bound to nobody (unmanaged, or the add-on's own account). One subject is on one row at most.

self.description: The add-on's own service account; it refuses to adopt or purge it.

state.description: The account's current values by entitlement field, in the manifest's vocabulary.

Conflict.description: A binding that names nothing in this read: the subject, and the account that holds its name or number (the holder, never the subject's account).
